info.title: vellum-preflight — PDF/A and PDF/UA preflight validator
info.description: Native-AOT command-line preflight tool for VellumPdf: validates PDF files against PDF/A-2b/2u/2a and PDF/UA-1 conformance levels. Outputs text, JSON, or SARIF reports.

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Profiles to check: 2b 2u 2a ua1 auto all
Comma-separated or repeated. Default: auto

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text json sarif. Default: text

options.name: --output
options.description: Write output to file instead of stdout

options.name: --severity
options.description: Min severity of failures to show: error warning info. Default: error

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit-code threshold: error warning info none. Default: error

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colour (also honoured via NO_COLOR env var)

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Print rule coverage for a profile (or all) and exit

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help and exit
PROFILES
2b    PDF/A-2 Level B (basic)
2u    PDF/A-2 Level U (Unicode)
2a    PDF/A-2 Level A (accessible)
ua1   PDF/UA-1 (universal accessibility)
auto  Detect from the file's XMP claim (default)
all   Run all four profiles
EXIT CODES
0   All files conformant
1   One or more files non-conformant (failure >= --fail-on threshold)
2   Usage or I/O error (bad args, file not found, not a PDF)
